messages:
jules.prod: quick Q from today's all-hands about API/Console/Optimize timelines 
 tara.pm: go for it
 jules.prod: 1) API latency variants 
 will these be a new model name or just routing-level variants? 
 tara.pm: routing-level only, same model id. we'll surface variant metadata and a response header. 
 evan.eng: implementation note: header will be `x-rw-variant`. sample: `x-rw-variant: latency-v1`. 
 jules.prod: 2) Console per-route cost GA window? backfill length? 
 tara.pm: GA next quarter, beta in ~4 weeks. hosted gets 90d backfill; Dedicated/Private start from agent upgrade. 
 jules.prod: 3) Optimize suggestions: auto-apply vs dry-run? 
 evan.eng: one-click apply in Console plus an API. dry-run shows estimated savings and risk note. suggestions carry a confidence score. 
 jules.prod: canary defaults & rollback triggers? 
 evan.eng: default canary: 5%/24h -> 25%/48h. auto-rollback on error rate >1% absolute or p95 +30% vs baseline. alerts to eng-oncall and release channel. 
 marie.cto: we'll publish FAQ + migration checklist before beta opens. teams with potential breaking deps, please flag now. 
 release-bot: scheduled canary dry-run 2026-07-10T05:00:00Z to cluster-eu-1. 
 jules.prod: cheers, i'll draft a short customer-facing FAQ and ping the beta list when available.
